lines.en: High up in the sky lived the Sun and the Wind.
segs: High up in the sky lived the Sun and the Wind.

lines.en: Shall we tap the Sun?
Tap the smiling Sun!
"I'm the warmest!"
Now tap the Wind!
Tap the puffy-cheeked Wind!
"No way, I'm the strongest!"
The Sun and the Wind both say they're the best.
A traveler is walking down the road below.
The traveler is wearing a thick coat.

lines.text: 바람이 말했어요. "저 외투를 먼저 벗기는 쪽이 이기기!"
lines.en: The Wind said, "Whoever makes that coat come off first wins!"
segs: Whoever makes that coat come off first wins!

lines.text: 해님이 웃었어요. "좋아. 바람아, 너 먼저 해 봐."
lines.en: The Sun smiled. "Okay. Wind, you go first."
The Wind puffed out big, round cheeks.
segs: The Wind puffed out big, round cheeks.

lines.text: 화면을 쓱 밀어서 바람을 불어 줘요!
lines.en: Swipe the screen to blow the Wind!

lines.text: 화면을 쓱 밀어서 바람을 불어 봐요!
lines.en: Swipe the screen and blow the Wind!
Stronger now! Swish!
Whoosh~ The leaves are flying away!
segs: Whoosh~ The leaves are flying away!

lines.en: "Oh no, my hat!" The hat flew far, far away.
segs: The hat flew far, far away.

lines.en: The coat flap-flap-flaps!
"Brrr, it's cold!" The traveler held the coat tight.
segs: The traveler held the coat tight.

lines.text: 단추까지 꼭꼭 채웠어요. 외투는 꼼짝도 안 해요!
lines.en: Every button is buttoned up tight. The coat won't budge!
segs: Every button is buttoned up tight. The coat won't budge!

lines.en: The Wind blew even harder. Swish!

lines.text: 바람은 숨이 차서 헉헉, 볼이 쭈글쭈글해졌어요.
lines.en: The Wind ran out of breath, huff puff, and its cheeks went all wrinkly.
segs: The Wind ran out of breath, huff puff, and its cheeks went all wrinkly.

lines.en: "Aw, it's not working!"

lines.text: 어? 날아간 모자가 나그네 머리에 쏙 떨어졌어요!
lines.en: Oh? The hat that flew away dropped right onto the traveler's head!
Now it's the Sun's turn.

lines.text: 해님을 꾹 눌러서 따뜻하게 비춰 줘요!
lines.en: Press and hold the Sun to shine nice and warm!
Press and hold the Sun!
"Ahh, so warm~" The traveler unbuttoned the coat.
Hold a little longer!
"Phew, it's hot!" The traveler fans with the hat.
segs: The traveler fans with the hat.

lines.en: Hold one more time!
Off it goes! The traveler took off the coat!
segs: Off it goes! The traveler took off the coat!

lines.en: The Wind was so surprised. "Wow, the Sun did it!"

lines.text: 바람이 불 때, 나그네는 외투를 꽉 여몄어요.
lines.en: When the Wind blew, the traveler held the coat tight.
When the Sun shone, the traveler took the coat off.

lines.text: 누가 외투를 벗게 했을까요? 해님일까요, 바람일까요?
lines.en: Who made the traveler take off the coat? Was it the Sun, or the Wind?
Who made the traveler take off the coat?

lines.text: 외투를 벗은 나그네 쪽 하늘을 봐요!
lines.en: Look at the sky by the traveler without the coat!
It's the Sun! Tap the sparkling Sun!
That's right, it's the Sun! The warm Sun won!
segs: That's right, it's the Sun! The warm Sun won!

lines.text: 세게 미는 것보다 다정한 게 더 힘이 세요.
lines.en: Being gentle is stronger than pushing hard.
segs: Being gentle is stronger than pushing hard.

lines.text: 눈이 펑펑 오는 날엔 무엇을 입을까요?
lines.en: What should we wear on a snowy day?
On cold days, warm clothes are best.
The coat! Tap the sparkling one!
That's right! Wearing a warm coat feels so cozy.
segs: That's right! Wearing a warm coat feels so cozy.

lines.en: What should we wear on a bright, sunny day?
On hot days, cool clothes are best.
The short sleeves! Tap the sparkling one!
That's right! Wearing short sleeves feels so cool.
segs: That's right! Wearing short sleeves feels so cool.

lines.en: When it's cold, put it on. When it's hot, take it off.
The traveler is resting by the stream.
The traveler dipped both feet into the cool water, splash!

lines.text: 바람아, 이번엔 살살 불어 줄래? 쓱, 살살~
lines.en: Wind, could you blow gently this time? Swish, gently~
segs: Wind, could you blow gently this time? Swish, gently~

lines.en: Swipe gently!
"Ahh, so cool. Thank you, Wind!"
segs: Ahh, so cool. Thank you, Wind!

lines.en: The Sun and the Wind looked at each other and smiled.
segs: The Sun and the Wind looked at each other and smiled.

lines.en: "Let's be good friends!"

lines.text: 하늘을 톡 눌러서 날씨를 바꿔 볼까요?
lines.en: Shall we tap the sky to change the weather?
The clothes change by themselves, too!

lines.text: 해님과 바람은 오늘도 사이좋게 하늘을 지켜요.
lines.en: The Sun and the Wind watch over the sky together again today.

lines.text: 다정한 마음이 제일 힘이 세답니다. 끝!
lines.en: Kindness is the strongest power of all. The end!
segs: Kindness is the strongest power of all. The end!

ui.누가 외투를 벗길까?: Who will make the coat come off?
